# SetMenuText

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Menus](BlitzPlus-Menus)

</div>


```blitzbasic
SetMenuText:Void menu:Int32, text:String
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `menu` | In | Int32 | required | Handle of a menu or item. |
| `text` | In | String | required | The new text. |

## Description

Changes the text of a menu title or item.

## Differences

* The text can be read back with [MenuText](MenuText) here. The original cannot read it.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win  = CreateWindow("Text", 10, 10, 300, 150, Desktop(), 15)
file = CreateMenu("File", 0, WindowMenu(win))
item = CreateMenu("Start", 1, file)
UpdateWindowMenu win
Repeat
	e = WaitEvent()
	If e = $1001 Then SetMenuText item, "Stop" : UpdateWindowMenu win
Until e = $803
```
